newsitem.title: USA: Waban says raises tender offer for notes.
newsitem.headline: Waban says raises tender offer for notes.

text.p: Waban Inc said on Wednesday that it has increased its offer to buy all $100 million of its 11 percent senior subordinated notes due May 15, 2004.

The amount payable for the notes tendered has been calculated to result in a yield to May 15, 1999 a total equal to the sum of the comparable Treasury yield plus 50 basis points, plus accrued interest, Waban said in a statement.
The previous offer was for a comparable yield plus 75 basis points, which was for a lower price, Waban said.
The offer and withdrawal rights expire 0800 EDT on July 17, 1997, the company said.
